tasks.title: W13-00 - Google Ads Coordination & Financial Risk Freeze
actions: 1. Revalidate W05-W08 and current authority interfaces.
2. Freeze domain scope across Search, PMax, Display, YouTube assets, keywords and conversions.
3. Define provider/account binding, financial-risk classes, paused-first/staging rules and publication barriers.
4. Use TOCA Google Ads references via semantic re-specification with source SHA/provenance.
5. Create premortem for overspend, wrong CID/MCC, duplicate mutations, stale conversion config and quota failures.
tasks.forbidden: Do not infer Google Ads coverage from n8n corpus.

tasks.title: W13-A - Google Ads Domain Contracts & Capability Plans
actions: 1. Define Google Ads domain intents/capabilities and external ID mappings.
2. Model financial impact, reversibility and target resources.
3. Support Search/PMax/Display/YouTube/keyword/conversion capability planning.
4. Keep plans provider-aware but authority-neutral.
5. Add schema/contract tests.
tasks.forbidden: No credentials or executable permission inside plans.

tasks.title: W13-B - Account Verifier, Binding & Read Surfaces
actions: 1. Re-specify TOCA account verifier/client patterns behind W08.
2. Bind tenant to customer/MCC/account explicitly.
3. Normalize safe read operations and provider health.
4. Treat verified account as precondition only.
5. Test wrong customer ID, hierarchy mismatch and tenant leakage.

tasks.title: W13-C - Search, Keywords & Conversion Planning
actions: 1. Implement planning for keywords, match types, negatives, bids/targets and conversion prerequisites.
2. Use verified provider/context facts and W05 reasoning where necessary.
3. Separate recommendations/confidence from financial execution.
4. Validate compatibility and required conversion state.
5. Add deterministic/benchmark tests.

tasks.title: W13-D - PMax / Display / YouTube Asset Planning
actions: 1. Model asset groups/assets/channel-specific requirements.
2. Validate provider constraints and required media metadata.
3. Use deterministic templates when known; escalate ambiguous creative strategy.
4. Carry provenance and expected costs/risk.
5. Add missing/invalid asset and provider-constraint tests.

tasks.title: W13-E - Governed Paused-First Operations
actions: 1. Implement create/update operations through W07/W08 Google Ads transport.
2. Use paused/non-serving state where appropriate before activation.
3. Enforce idempotency/current authority/preconditions/readback.
4. Handle partial mutations and EXECUTION_UNCERTAIN.
5. Test provider retry/quota/timeout behavior.
tasks.ownership: W13 domain commands composed over W07/W08.
tasks.forbidden: No bypass of executor or current policy.

tasks.title: W13-F - Financial Budget, Approval & Policy Enforcement
actions: 1. Map spend/bid/budget-sensitive actions to required authority/approval/constraints.
2. Fail closed on stale precheck, missing approval, budget ceiling or wrong account.
3. Prove strategy/confidence cannot widen authority.
4. Bound repeated optimization mutations.
5. Add attack/negative matrix.
tasks.forbidden: Do not create parallel finance authority.

tasks.title: W13-G - Analytics & Optimization Decision Support
actions: 1. Normalize Google Ads performance/conversion metrics.
2. Preserve freshness/provenance/account scope.
3. Generate optimization candidates as recommendations.
4. Expose eval/telemetry inputs for W17/W18.
5. Test delayed attribution and incomplete conversion data.

tasks.title: W13-H - Google Ads Readback, Reconciliation & Acceptance
actions: 1. Run read/create/update/paused/readback integration scenarios.
2. Test partial failure, wrong CID, quota/rate limit, stale policy and ambiguous provider state.
3. Run four Risk Gates and exact-head CI.
4. Document TOCA source patterns promoted/re-specified and n8n coverage gap.
5. Publish W13 acceptance/handoff.
